TOURNAMENT FORMAT & RULES

ALL-OUT at a glance.

This summary reflects the tournament format and registration rules shown on this portal.

Team composition

4-player mixed team: exactly 2 men + 2 women. One registered player is selected as Team Captain.

14

Maximum team DUPR: 14.00. Maximum individual player DUPR: 3.99.

16

Maximum team DUPR: 16.00. Maximum individual player DUPR: 4.49.

Match sequence

  • Women's Doubles
  • Men's Doubles
  • Mixed Doubles #1
  • Mixed Doubles #2

21-point games · rally scoring · win by 2.

Dreambreaker

If the team score is tied 2–2: play to 21, win by 2. Four players rotate every 4 points, switch ends at 11, with 1 timeout per team.

Registration & payment

Submission enters organizer review. Payment is not collected on submission and is requested only after eligibility approval. If the division is effectively full, a complete new submission enters the waitlist.

DUPR ID HELP

Where do I find my DUPR ID?

Enter the player's alphanumeric DUPR ID shown in DUPR, not the player's rating.

1. Open the player's DUPR profile

Use the official DUPR player profile for the person you are registering.

2. Find the DUPR ID

Copy the player's alphanumeric DUPR ID exactly as shown in DUPR (for example, QNZ075).

3. Enter the rating separately

The DUPR rating has its own field beside the DUPR ID. Do not paste the rating into the ID field.
